label.explanation: ingest-api's heap filled steadily with old-gen objects that full GCs could not reclaim (lines 99, 135, 179) until it hit OutOfMemoryError and was OOMKilled, repeatedly (lines 182, 183, 214, 215, 243, 244). The "started ingest-api" lines (lines 190, 220, 250) are crash-loop restarts of the same version v4.8.6, not a deploy. The bursts of ingest-gateway 502s (lines 185, 203, 211, 226, 242, 259, 261, 269, 281, 289, 303, 312) line up with each crash. Red herrings: line 189 (a one-off slow reporting query on audit_log, not on the failing request path); lines 151, 158 (a deploy of event-processor, which is not on the failing request path and kept processing normally); line 186 (a single API client being rate-limited, which is the limiter working as intended).
